resources.string: Where you are on the climb, time and distance to the top, time to your Strava PR
What Mountaineer shows above its climb graph at one tile.
Both: time to top big, your time vs PR under it.
The TO TOP bar and the climb graph always show.
Next to the climb icon wherever your PR shows.
Standard 8.0 kg (grey); type your own. With bottles and bags. Your own weight comes from your Karoo rider profile.
Each profile you pick on the Karoo shows up here. Not filled in: the one-for-all weight (grey).
No ride profiles yet: pick one on the Karoo\'s home screen and it shows up here.
Oh nice, a weight weenie build!
Head- and tailwind on each part of the climb, from the Open-Meteo forecast. No connection: no wind.
Logs each climb (your speed against your power, the gradient and the wind) and learns from it, so the time to top gets better with every climb.
The data stays on your Karoo and never leaves it.
Your PR comes from the Karoo\'s own Strava Live Segments (Karoo Settings › Strava). Climbs come from the route you load.
